# New-ZbxTemplateDashboard

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a template dashboard.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxTemplateDashboard [[-Name] <string>] [-Uuid <string>] [-TemplateId <ulong>] [-DisplayPeriod <int>] [-AutoStart <bool>] [-Page <ZabbixTemplateDashboardPageRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A template dashboard is a dashboard a template defines; each host linked to the template shows it with that host's data. The New-ZbxTemplateDashboard cmdlet sends templatedashboard.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new template dashboard back with templatedashboard.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -TemplateId and -Page; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a template dashboard

```powershell
New-ZbxTemplateDashboard -Name 'Web App overview' -TemplateId (Get-ZbxTemplate -Name 'Web App').TemplateId -Page (New-ZbxDashboardPage -Widget (New-ZbxDashboardWidget graph -Width 36 -Height 5))
```

Creates a template dashboard named Web App overview. The command writes the new template dashboard, read back from the server.
